// diagnostic E3511

Jet.GenerationCycle

Generated source has two producers, or waits on itself: `{chain}`.

What

Generated source has two producers, or waits on itself: `{chain}`.

Why

Each generated output has one producer and is checked before a step reads it, so what compiles never depends on which producer ran last and every step can start.

Fix

Give each generated module its own name, keep steps from writing a generated module's path, and have one step of a waiting chain read something no step in it makes.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GenerationCycle: Tests/UI/BuildGeneratedCycle/stderr.

Error: Jet.GenerationCycle: Build plan is invalid: module `alpha` is generated twice
  --> Tests/UI/BuildGeneratedCycle/run.jet:7:7
    |
  7 |     b.generate("alpha") {
    |       ^^^^^^^^
 Why: Each generated module and its path have one producer, so what compiles never depends on which producer ran last
 Fix: Give each generated module its own name, and keep steps from writing a generated module's path
